title: Singularity of Input-Output Matrices: Structural Linkages and Spectral Properties
abstract: arXiv:2208.00226v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Analyzing 5 historical and 670 contemporary input-output (IO) tables, we show that all of these IO matrices are singular. We map this phenomenon onto underlying production network topologies. While singularity trivially emerges from sectors lacking intermediate forward or backward linkages, it could frequently persist due to deeper economic properties: proportional cost structures across sectors, isolated economic sub-networks, and supply-chain hierarchies lacking intra-industry transactions. As a subset of these matrices is non-diagonalizable, we leverage this singularity to derive simple, rank and eigenvalue based diagnostic criteria for diagonalizability. This provides an efficient computational test for network shock propagation models using eigendecomposition.

translated_title: 投入产出矩阵的奇异性：结构关联与谱性质
translated_abstract: arXiv:2208.00226v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：通过分析5个历史性和670个当代投入产出（IO）表，我们表明所有这些IO矩阵都是奇异的。我们将这一现象映射到潜在的生产网络拓扑结构上。虽然奇异性可以从缺乏中间前向或后向关联的部门中平凡地产生，但它可能经常因更深层次的经济属性而持续存在：跨部门的比例成本结构、孤立的经济子网络，以及缺乏行业内交易的供应链层级。由于这些矩阵的一个子集不可对角化，我们利用这种奇异性推导出简单、基于秩和特征值的可对角化诊断标准。这为使用特征分解的网络冲击传播模型提供了一种高效的计算测试方法。
tldr: 本文发现所有历史及当代投入产出矩阵均为奇异，并将其归因于生产网络中的结构特征，进而提出基于秩和特征值的简单诊断标准，用于高效测试网络冲击传播模型的可对角化性。
en_tdlr: This paper discovers that all historical and contemporary input-output matrices are singular, attributes this to structural features in production networks, and proposes simple rank and eigenvalue-based criteria for efficiently testing diagonalizability in network shock propagation models.
